[[File:Norwelyn.png|alt=A leaping silver salmon on a background of blue and green vertical stripes|thumb|Sign of House Norwelyn]]'''House Norwelyn''' is one of the 19 Major [[:Category:Noble houses|Noble houses]] of [[Andor]]. Lord [[Luan Norwelyn]] is [[High Seat]] of House Norwelyn.

==Sigil==
The sigil of House Norwelyn is a leaping silver salmon on a field of vertical blue and green stripes.{{ref/book|twotc}}

==Activities==
House Norwelyn was once the Ruling House before [[House Mantear]] took power.{{ref/book|11|17}}

During the [[Third Succession War]], House Norwelyn supported [[House Trakand]] gaining the throne.

During the [[Fourth Succession War]], House Norwelyn was initially among the six neutral great Houses that stayed apart during the Siege of Caemlyn.{{ref/book|11|17}}

After the Siege of Caemlyn House Norwelyn supported [[Elayne Trakand]] due to [[Dyelin Taravin]]'s speech in her favour.{{ref/book|11|35}}
